correctness.rationale: Disjoint supports force the size ceiling; for disjoint two-support words the cyclic pair distance is exactly eight minus internal cycle adjacencies. Occupancy edge counting excludes stronger short-block codes at lengths at most nine. An Euler tour of a connected simple four-regular circulant graph gives half the word length, rounded down words for all lengths at least ten. For even lengths, all positions are filled and equality forces a connected simple four-regular transition graph; conversely its Euler circuit attains the metric condition. The actual standalone checker exhaustively tested lengths two through nine and validated explicit witnesses through length 150; finite checks are secondary to proof.
